section.content: 本发明提供了一种半导体集成电路，其包括：第一单元组，其中沿着该半导体集成电路的外周边的方向设置了多个用于外部输入和/或输出的I/O单元和/或电源单元；以及设置在所述第一单元组内侧的第二单元组，其中沿着该半导体集成电路的外周边的方向设置了多个用于外部输入和/或输出的I/O单元和/或电源单元。形成第二单元组的单元之间的间隔比形成第一单元组的单元之间的间隔宽。

A semiconductor integrated circuit is provided, which includes a first group of cells, in which a plural of I/O cells and/or power source cells for external input and/or output are arranged along a direction of the outer periphery of the semiconductor integrated circuit, and a second group of cells on an inner side of the first group of cells in which a plural of I/O cells and/or power source cells for external input and/or output are arranged along a direction of the outer periphery of the semiconductor integrated circuit. The intervals between the cells forming the second group of cells are wider than those between the cells forming the first group of cells.

Semiconductor integrated circuitThe application based on and require the priority of the No.2003-059834 of Japanese patent application formerly that submitted on March 6th, 2003, be incorporated herein by reference in full here.

Technical field

The present invention relates to a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit, particularly have the semiconductor integrated circuit of I/O (I/O) unit and/or power subsystem.

Background technology

In semiconductor integrated circuit, the I/O unit is set to multistage usually, and purpose is in order to adapt to the multiplication of pin.Being provided with at interval of I/O unit makes exterior I/O unit and inner I/O unit all be provided at predetermined intervals in multilevel hierarchy.

Fig. 7 A and 7B represent the semiconductor integrated circuit that the I/O unit is set to multistage structure that has according to first prior art.

Fig. 7 A represents the structure of semiconductor integrated circuit (semiconductor chip) 700.Semiconductor integrated circuit 700 has first module group 701, the second unit group 702 and the 3rd unit group 703 along its frame region, and the efficient circuit unit in the interior zone 704.Corresponding a plurality of I/O unit of first to the 3rd unit group 701 to 703 is provided with along the direction annular of neighboring.First module group 701, the second unit group 702 and the 3rd unit group 703 are respectively outermost unit group, the second outer side unit group and the 3rd outer side unit groups in the semiconductor integrated circuit 700.

Fig. 7 B is the zoomed-in view as the zone 705 of the part of the semiconductor integrated circuit shown in Fig. 7 A.Zone 705 comprises first module group 701, the second unit group 702 and the 3rd unit group 703.In each group in unit 701 to 703 a plurality of I/O unit 711 is set.In this structure, the size of I/O unit 711 is constant with being provided with at interval.Unit rigid line in I/O unit 711 and the interior zone 704 is connected (Fig. 7 A).Therefore, a unit group is provided with inwardly more, and the distribution in the distribution area 712 therein between the I/O unit 711 is just difficult more.For example, under the situation of distribution 713, it is infeasible carrying out distribution, because there is not remaining distribution passage.Even when coaxial distribution, also need long circuitous coiling, so the length of distribution can be very long.In addition, as the situation of distribution area 712, a unit group is provided with inwardly more, and distribution is crowded more, becomes to be easier to crosstalk.Under its worst situation, can not realize required performance.

Fig. 8 A and 8B show the semiconductor integrated circuit that the I/O unit is set to multistage structure that has according to second prior art.Fig. 8 A shows the structure of the semiconductor integrated circuit 700 shown in Fig. 7 A.Fig. 8 B is the zoomed-in view as the zone 805 of the part of semiconductor integrated circuit shown in Fig. 8 A.Zone 805 comprises first module group 701, the second unit group 702 and the 3rd unit group 703.A plurality of I/O unit 811 is set in first module group 701.A plurality of I/O unit 812 is set in the second unit group 702, and the size of each in them is all less than I/O unit 811.In the 3rd unit group 703 I/O unit 813 is set, the size of each in them is all less than I/O unit 812.The element number of unit group 701 to 703 is identical.

In said structure, the unit group is provided with inwardly more, and the size of its I/O unit is more little.Thereby, as in distribution area 814, seeing, there is not a distribution difficulty thereby this distribution area is enough wide.Yet, because the unit group that is provided with more inwardly comprises less I/O unit, therefore must prepare polytype I/O unit with identical function, therefore can expend a large amount of man-hours that are used to develop.In addition, have following problem, under the situation of transistorized even structure, it is lower that the static of less I/O unit bears voltage usually.

Another prior art is also disclosed in the patent documentation 1 below.

Summary of the invention

The objective of the invention is to eliminate in the I/O configuration of cells is the distribution congested problem of distribution area in the I/O unit group that is provided with of the inboard of multistage semiconductor integrated circuit.

Another object of the present invention is to prevent that the I/O configuration of cells from being that the static of the I/O unit of multistage semiconductor integrated circuit bears voltage and reduces.

Another purpose of the present invention is to reduce to be used to develop the quantity in man-hour that the I/O configuration of cells is the I/O unit of multistage semiconductor integrated circuit.

According to an aspect of the present invention, provide a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit, having comprised: the first module group, wherein the direction along the neighboring is provided with a plurality of I/O unit and/or power subsystems that are used for outside input and/or output; Be arranged on the second unit group of the inboard of first module group, wherein the direction along the neighboring is provided with a plurality of I/O unit and/or power subsystems that are used for outside input and/or output.The interval that forms between the unit of the second unit group is wideer than the interval between the unit that forms the first module group.

In the present invention, the interval that forms between the unit of the second unit group is wideer than the interval between the unit that forms the first module group, and the distribution that therefore can eliminate in the distribution area of the inboard unit group that is provided with is crowded.In addition, when the element number that forms the second unit group when forming the element number of first module group, needn't reduce the size of the second unit group.Thereby, can prevent that the static of I/O unit and/or power subsystem from bearing the voltage reduction.In addition, form measure-alike that the size of the unit of the second unit group can be with the unit that forms the first module group, this has reduced exploitation I/O unit and/or the required quantity in man-hour of power subsystem.

Embodiment

-the first embodiment-

Figure 1A and 1B represent according to the multistage I/O unit of wherein being provided with of first embodiment of the invention and/or the semiconductor integrated circuit of power subsystem.

Figure 1A shows the formation of semiconductor integrated circuit (semiconductor chip) 100.Semiconductor integrated circuit 100 comprise along first module group 101, the second unit group 102 and the 3rd unit group 103 of its frame region with and interior zone 104 in the circuit unit that is provided with of inboard.In in first to the 3rd unit group 101 to 103 each, corresponding a plurality of I/O unit is set along the direction annular of neighboring.First module group 101, the second unit group 102 and the 3rd unit group 103 are respectively outermost unit group, the second outer side unit group and the 3rd outer side unit groups in the semiconductor integrated circuit 100.

Should be noted that unit group 101 to 103 is not limited to the unit group that is only formed by the I/O unit, also can be formed by I/O unit and/or power subsystem.The I/O unit has and is used for externally importing and/or the input buffer and/or the output buffer of output signal.Power subsystem is the unit that is connected to external power source current potential or reference potential.The I/O unit receives power supply according to the mode from power subsystem supply power equipotential line and reference potential line.Each group in the unit group 101 to 103 all pass through the power supply potential line with reference potential line and annular the connection.

Figure 1B is the zoomed-in view as the zone 105 of the part of semiconductor integrated circuit shown in Figure 1A.Zone 105 comprises first module group 101, the second unit group 102 and the 3rd unit group 103.In each group in unit group 101 to 103 a plurality of I/O unit and/or power subsystem 111 are set.This is so a kind of structure, and wherein the multiple unit group is with three grades of settings, and in unit group 101 in 103 the size of unit 111 be consistent.

Interval between the unit 111 of the second unit group 102 is wideer than first module group, and the quantity of unit 111 that forms the second unit group 102 is less than the quantity of the unit 111 that forms first module group 101.In addition, the interval between the unit 111 of the 3rd unit group 103 is wideer than the second unit group 102, and the quantity of unit 111 that forms the 3rd unit group 103 is less than the quantity of the unit 111 that forms the second unit group 102.

In the present embodiment, the unit group is provided with inwardly more, and being provided with of its unit 111 is wide more at interval.This structure makes that the space of distribution area is enough, as seeing in distribution area 112, does not wherein have the distribution congested problem, and can prevent owing to crosstalking that distribution produces.

-the second embodiment-

Fig. 2 A and 2B represent according to the multistage I/0 unit of wherein being provided with of second embodiment of the invention and/or the semiconductor integrated circuit of power subsystem.

Fig. 2 A represents to be equivalent to the structure of the semiconductor integrated circuit 100 of first embodiment shown in Figure 1A.Fig. 2 B is the zoomed-in view as the zone 205 of the part of semiconductor integrated circuit shown in Fig. 2 A.Zone 205 comprises first module group 101, the second unit group 102 and the 3rd unit group 103.This is so a kind of structure, and wherein the multiple unit group is with three grades of settings, and comprises the unit of two kinds of different sizes, i.e. unit 211 and 213.In first module group 101, the unit 211 of consistent size is set.The second unit group 102 comprises a plurality of unit 211, wherein has the size a small amount of unit 213 bigger than unit 211.According to the standard of semiconductor integrated circuit, larger-size unit 213 is arranged in the second unit group 102 possibly.Being provided with second unit group Unit 102 for first module group 101 is consistent at interval.In the 3rd unit group 103 unit 211 is set, their size is consistent.Form wide than the second unit group 102 of interval between the unit of the 3rd unit group 103, and the element number that forms the 3rd unit group 103 is less than the element number that forms the second unit group 102.

Because the outside in the first module group 101 of most external setting or not the holding wire that is connected to internal element, therefore the unit that forms unit group 101 be provided with at interval aspect needn't consider the holding wire congested problem.

In addition, though the cell size difference, as employed unit 211 and unit 213 here, also can be enough according to the formation of present embodiment so that be used for the space of distribution area, as in distribution area 212, seeing.Though introduced the unit of two kinds of different sizes as the example of present embodiment, promptly the situation of unit 211 and unit 213 need not illustrate, above-mentioned explanation also is applicable to the situation of three or more different size unit.

It should be noted that though in the example in front, being provided with of its adjacent inner unit group group 102 in being arranged on outermost unit group 101 and being arranged on the second level is consistent at interval, what the interval of the second unit group 102 can be than unit group 101 is wide.

Be further noted that, in above-mentioned first and second preferred embodiments, show that to be provided with for unit unit group 101 each group in 103 all be a kind of situation of fixing at interval, but be provided with at interval and needn't fix for this unit unit group 101 each group in 103.In other words, the interval between the unit 211 in the unit group 101 needs not to be unanimity.As mentioned above, as long as it is wideer at interval to be positioned at being provided with of more inner unit group, being provided with at interval of each unit group needn't be fixed.In addition, having under the situation of three grades or more multistage multilevel hierarchy, as long as the unit of the unit group group of outermost 101 adjacent interior side unit group groups 102 with it is consistent at interval, and be used for arranging be positioned at the 3rd or the interval of the unit of unit, the inside group of back level wideer than the interval of external unit group 101 and 102, then the unit of each unit group is provided with at interval and needn't fixes.

Fig. 3 A represents to be equivalent to the formation of the semiconductor integrated circuit 100 of first embodiment shown in Figure 1A.On this semiconductor integrated circuit 100, provide the zone projection (metal coupling) 306 of two-dimentional setting.

Fig. 3 B represents the zoomed-in view as the zone 305 of the part of semiconductor integrated circuit shown in Fig. 3 A.Zone 305 comprises first module group 101, the second unit group 102 and the 3rd unit group 103.In each group in unit group 101 to 103, a plurality of I/O unit and/or power subsystem 111 are set, the same with first embodiment shown in Figure 1B, be consistent for the size of each these unit of group, unit.Be arranged on zone projection 306 on the semiconductor integrated circuit 100 comprise signal projection 316, be used for the projection 317 of power supply potential and be used for reference to () projection 318 of current potential.

Semiconductor integrated circuit 100 has the pad of the point-like plane contact that is used to be connected to zone projection 316 to 318.This pad is arranged on projection 316 below 318.Unit 111 is connected to projection 316 to 318 by distribution 311 and pad.Signal projection 316 is connected to the I/O unit by this pad.The projection 318 that is used for the projection 317 of power supply potential and is used for reference potential is connected to power subsystem by pad.Pad can be arranged on the outside or the inboard of unit 111.

Under the situation of zone projection structure, be similar to first embodiment, interval between the unit 111 of the second unit group 102 is wideer than the interval between the unit 111 of first module group 101, and the quantity of unit 111 that forms the second unit group 102 is less than the quantity of the unit 111 that forms first module group 101.Interval between the unit 111 of the 3rd unit group 103 is wideer than the interval between the unit 111 of the second unit group 102, and the quantity of unit 111 that forms the 3rd unit group 103 is less than the quantity of the unit 111 that forms the second unit group 102.

Fig. 4 is the profile of the semiconductor integrated circuit of above-mentioned zone projection cube structure.Semiconductor chip 404 has pad 403.Zone projection 402 is arranged between pad 403 and the pedestal 401, so that they are linked together.

-Di four embodiment-

Fig. 5 A represents to be equivalent to the formation of the semiconductor integrated circuit 100 of first embodiment shown in Figure 1A, except this semiconductor integrated circuit is made of the first module group 101 and the second unit group 102.

Fig. 5 B represents the zoomed-in view as the zone 505 of the part of semiconductor integrated circuit shown in Fig. 5 A.Zone 505 comprises the first module group 101 and the second unit group 102.In each unit group 101 and 102, a plurality of I/O unit and/or power subsystem 111 are set, be consistent for the size of each these unit of group, unit, this is identical with first embodiment shown in Figure 1B.Pad 511 can be the wire bond pad for example, and is arranged on the unit 111.Unit 111 is connected to pad 511 by distribution 512.

Under the situation of wire bond structure, similar with first embodiment, interval between the unit 111 of the second unit group 102 is wideer than the interval between the unit 111 of first module group, and it is littler than the quantity of the unit 111 that forms first module group 101 to form the quantity of unit 111 of the second unit group 102.

Fig. 6 is the profile of the semiconductor integrated circuit of above-mentioned wire bond structure.Semiconductor chip 602 has pad 603.Metal wire 604 is arranged on pad 603 and comprises between the encapsulation 601 of lead-in wire, by welding they are linked together.

Be similar to first embodiment, this structure makes more inner unit group have wideer being provided with at interval, therefore needn't make the unit of different size for each unit group.Thereby this semiconductor integrated circuit can guarantee that there are enough spaces the distribution area.In addition, be similar to second embodiment, there are being three grades or more in the multi-level unit structure of multi-level unit, unit group 102 in the second level that is arranged on the adjacent inboard of outermost unit group 101 is defined as basic status so that form unit group 103 the unit be provided with at interval than the unit of its adjacent external unit group 102 that the interval is set is wide.

Said structure has been eliminated the distribution congested problem in the cell layout region of the unit group of inside setting.In addition, this is not to make the more structure of junior unit for more inner unit group, can prevent because the reduction that the static of I/O unit that reasons in structure produces and/or power subsystem bears voltage.In addition, this is not to make the more structure of junior unit for more inner unit group, needn't prepare the unit of different size for each unit group, has reduced exploitation I/O unit and/or the required quantity in man-hour of power subsystem thus.

Consider present embodiment in all respects just schematically with nonrestrictive, implication and all interior improvement of scope of therefore falling into the equivalence of claim all should be included in the scope of the present invention.Under the situation that does not break away from spirit of the present invention or key feature, the present invention can implement with other concrete form.

As previously described, because the interval that forms between the unit of the second unit group is wideer than the interval between the unit that forms the first module group, so can eliminate distribution congested problem in the distribution area of the unit group that is provided with in inside.In addition, therefore the element number of the second unit group needn't dwindle the unit of the second unit group less than the element number of first module group, can prevent that thus the static of I/O unit and/or power subsystem from bearing the reduction of voltage.In addition, it can be consistent forming the unit of the second unit group and the size of the unit that forms the first module group, therefore can reduce the man-hour that is used to develop I/O unit and/or power subsystem.
